stem: Ben wants to improve the transition between the fourth paragraph (sentences 20–27) and the fifth paragraph (sentences 28–31). Which of the following should replace sentence 28 to help accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: But the playscapes are not all this museum has to offer; it also has some unique displays.

options.label: B
options.text: There are actually some other things this unique museum has to offer, and they are inside the museum as well.

options.label: C
options.text: At this museum people can enjoy creative and unusual playscapes; they are available both day and night.

options.label: D
options.text: If this isn’t enough, there are some other things for you to do when you visit this museum.
